Lines 1–10, 12 and 16 are therefore zero, line 11 is Form 1099-DIV box 2b alone, and line 17 combines a non-negative line 14, a line 15 carried as a negative number (i1040sd p. 13, line 15: "Enter the (loss), if any, from Schedule D, line 7. If Schedule D, line 7, is zero or a gain, enter -0-") and a zero line 16, so "Combine lines 14 through 16. If the result is a (loss), enter it as a positive amount. The refusal sits on Schedule D and the sale, not on this line's derivation, so the rendered English the reviewer saw did not name it.
